topic_title: Course Summary, Master Principles & Final Synthesis
prompt: Under Texas law, which children must be secured in a child passenger safety seat system?

options.text: Children younger than 5 years old, regardless of physical standing height
Children younger than 12 years old, unless weighing over eighty-five pounds
Children younger than 8 years old, unless taller than 4 feet 9 inches in height
Children are required to use booster seats only until their fourth birthday
